## Rule

task311 = ARC-GEN **c9e6f938**. **Horizontal mirror-stack** of a 3×3 grid (orange-only pixels): output is 3×6 = each row followed by its column-reverse — `out[r] = [in[r,0], in[r,1], in[r,2], in[r,2], in[r,1], in[r,0]]` — cols 6–29 / rows 3–29 background-padded. Generator (`external/ARC-GEN/tasks/task_c9e6f938.py`, `output[r][2*size-1-c] = output[r][c] = grid[r][c] = common.orange()`) is `size=3` **always**.

**task311 ships the BYTE-IDENTICAL graph to task164** (verified 2026-05-31: `task164.onnx == task311.onnx` byte-for-byte). Same horizontal-mirror SHAPE rule; the Gather is color-agnostic so task164 (colors 1/6/8) and task311 (orange) share one graph. **Full floor proof + empirical sub-30 sweep live in [`task164.md`](task164.md)** — this is the column-axis (W) sibling of task172/210 (row-axis V).

## Algorithm sketch

`out[...,c] = in[...,idx[c]]` on the COLUMN axis (axis=3), `idx = [0,1,2, 2,1,0, 3×24]`. One node:

```
Gather(input[1,10,30,30] F32, idx INT64[30], axis=3) → output[1,10,30,30]
```

## Cost analysis

Gather(input, idx[30], axis=3 W): forward+mirror W concat [c0,c1,c2,c2,c1,c0,bg x24]. Cost=30 is entirely the idx initializer (30 params). Memory=0 because the Gather output IS the model output tensor -- ORT does not allocate a separate intermediate for it. Already at minimum achievable cost; no cheaper equivalent algorithm found.

## Crop-to-active-grid analysis (2026-05-19, worker-7)

**Result: NOT VIABLE — Gather output is the model output; crop adds memory.**

This task has a single `Gather(input [1,10,30,30], idx[30], axis=2-or-3)` node. The Gather output IS the model's final output tensor; ORT does not count it in internal memory tracking (memory=0). The advisory's "30×30 intermediate" is this output tensor.

Any prepended `Slice(input→[1,10,N,30])` would create a new counted intermediate (e.g. [1,10,4,30]=4800 bytes for task116), catastrophically increasing cost from 30→4830+.

Additionally, output rows 6–29 map to a background input row (idx values ≥ N after the active region); padding with zeros would produce incorrect (non-background) output values.

**Do NOT attempt crop for this task in future sessions.**
